Name: AT Snowpeople
Author: EnbyFelix
Description:
50 retextures of the red candy cane you can buy at the night market into snowpeople for Alternative Textures.

The snowmen are just retextures, so they will not melt.

Update 1.0.1: Now you can change all three types of scarecrows, "Dancing Grass", Needlepoint Flower, S. Pine, and the House Plant to the snowpeople.
